shapeSummary: U-channel 48 mm long (Z), 48 mm wide (X), 12 mm tall (Y) with 2.5 mm base and walls, bottom at Y=0. Base has a 14 mm central through bore and a 4x4 grid of 4 mm holes at 8 mm pitch (±8, ±16). Each upright flange has 5 holes of 4 mm diameter at 8 mm pitch, 8 mm above the base's outer face.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified and come from the image analysis and drawing estimates.
The product name says '1 Hole', but the flange pattern was modeled with 5 holes as the image shows.
The slots around the central bore were omitted because their dimensions are uncertain.
The image appears to show additional base holes, for example on the center row and column, which were not modeled because the analysis does not list them.
Hole diameters of 4 mm and 14 mm are estimates; the flange holes look slightly larger in the image.
The analysis axes (Z up) were remapped to Y up: length runs along Z and width along X.
cadquery:
base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(48, 12, 48, centered=(True, False, True))
inner = cq.Workplane('XY').box(43, 10, 52, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((0, 2.5, 0))
part = base.cut(inner)
grid = [(x, z) for x in (-16, -8, 8, 16) for z in (-16, -8, 8, 16)]
base_holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints(grid).circle(2).extrude(-2.5)
bore = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(7).extrude(-2.5)
flange_holes = (cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-25)
    .pushPoints([(8, z) for z in (-16, -8, 0, 8, 16)]).circle(2).extrude(50))
part = part.cut(base_holes).cut(bore).cut(flange_holes)
